title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers' Will Klein in the third inning.
Contreras walked to first base but was replaced defensively in the next inning by Nick Sogard.
Contreras leads the Red Sox in batting average (.288), OPS (.943), and home runs (23) this season.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after Patriots training camp stint.
Hopkins, 34, previously played for Tennessee Titans and coached briefly with Patriots under Mike Vrabel.
Hopkins has not officially retired from NFL, focusing on coaching role at Georgia Tech for now.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for spots on the Patriots' 53-man roster amid strong preseason performances.
NFL teams typically carry six wide receivers, but the Patriots may deviate due to the depth and talent of their squad.
The resolution of Kayshon Boutte's situation could impact roster decisions, potentially affecting Chism and Williams' roster chances.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer, a Blue Jays outfielder, is open to a trade to the Boston Red Sox before the trade deadline.
The Red Sox are considering a trade for Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards amid injuries in their infield.
Springer, a four-time All-Star, has strong past performance at Fenway Park but is experiencing a down season.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is now available on Hulu.
'The Drama,' starring Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is a Boston-set dark comedy streaming on HBO Max.
'Furious' Season 1, a series about an FBI rookie and a serial killer, is streaming on Hulu.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran criticized teammates during Red Sox vs. Athletics game for not tagging up on a fly ball.
NESN and WEEI broadcasts expressed confusion and frustration over Duran's on-field outburst.
The Red Sox are open to trading Duran ahead of the MLB trade deadline amid his latest behavior.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown are building chemistry during the Patriots' training camp in Foxborough.
Maye connected with Brown for several completions, particularly improving in the last two days of camp.
Maye is focusing on involving Brown more in plays, fostering open communication to enhance their connection.

title: Drake Maye, A.J. Brown heat up and other takeaways from Day 6 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye showed precision at Patriots training camp, completing 11-for-11 in 11-on-11 drills, connecting frequently with A.J. Brown.
Patriots wideout Romeo Doubs made a standout play, catching a fade pass from Maye in the red zone despite tight coverage.
Veteran cornerback Carlton Davis III remained absent from practice after an apparent injury during a 7-on-7 drill earlier in the week.

title: Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Massachusetts dropped to No. 11 in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings, from ninth in 2025.
Massachusetts ranked second in healthcare, praised for its legislative impact and universal health care coverage.
Challenges include low rankings in fiscal stability (39th), infrastructure (38th), and opportunity (41st).

title: Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: IHOP has closed its Cambridge location at 16 Eliot St. and its Hyannis location at 790 Iyannough Road.
Despite the closures, approximately 19 IHOP restaurants remain open across Massachusetts.
IHOP's closures may be due to decreased foot traffic or expired leases, not a broader restructuring.
